{{Quote|According to my operatives, the Tierfon Sector Fleet isn't planning to launch their attack for three weeks&hellip;|Chief of Intelligence Vernan, 251st Meeting of the Alliance High Command|<ref name="251st" />}}
The '''Tierfon Sector Fleet''' was an Imperial [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleet]] assigned to the [[Sumitra sector/Legends|Tierfon sector]], under the command of [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] [[Tzenkens]]. After the [[Tocan system disaster]], the Fleet had to undergo rest and refit. This allowed the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to withdraw [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] wings from [[Tierfon/Legends|Tierfon]], [[Homon/Legends|Homon]] and [[Farstey/Legends|Farstey]] to participate in [[Operation Cobolt]].<ref name="251st" />
